]


def run_eval(test_data, mode, gru_ckpt, deberta_ckpt, model_name, output_file):
    cmd = [
        sys.executable, str(PROJ / "src/evaluate.py"),
        "--test_data", str(test_data),
        "--mode", mode,
        "--gru_checkpoint", gru_ckpt,
        "--output_file", str(output_file),
